claims.explanation: Icariin is a PDE5A inhibitor that raises cGMP and modulates PI3K/Akt/NF-kB signaling, and its selective killing tracks with intact cGMP/PKG-dependent apoptotic signaling rather than with any single lineage. Lines with TP53 loss and activated RAS/RTK-MAPK or PI3K-AKT growth signaling appear most sensitive, while lines with intact PTEN/PI3K-AKT survival signaling or low PDE5A/cGMP-pathway expression are relatively protected. The pattern is best explained by cGMP-mediated apoptosis being unmasked in cells that depend on MAPK/PI3K survival input and lack p53-mediated adaptation.

features.basis: TP53 mutation is nearly universal among the most-killed lines and absent from several protected lines, consistent with loss of p53-dependent survival adaptation to cGMP/PKG stress
PDE5A is the annotated icariin target; higher PDE5A expression predicts greater cGMP-pathway dependence and drug effect
PTEN loss/PTEN-mutant lines (FTC133, UACC62, 786O, HEC265, ZR751) are enriched among least-affected lines, suggesting intact PI3K-AKT survival signaling is required for sensitivity
PIK3CA-mutant lines (HGC27, KYSE510, SNU840) appear among protected lines, consistent with PI3K-AKT-driven survival counteracting icariin
BRAF-mutant melanomas (K029AX, UACC62, IGR37) are among the most-killed lines, suggesting MAPK-addicted cells are vulnerable to cGMP/PKG-mediated apoptosis
NRAS-mutant lines (IPC298, KU1919) show sensitivity, consistent with RAS-MAPK dependence increasing reliance on cGMP-regulated survival
NF1 loss (KALS1, BICR6, S117, FTC133) activates RAS-MAPK and is enriched in the killed set
EGFR-mutant NSCLC lines (HCC4006, NCIH1650, KYSE270) are split but several are protected, suggesting EGFR-driven survival signaling blunts icariin
CDKN2A loss (IPC298, K029AX, MHHES1) is common in killed lines and may impair cell-cycle checkpoint response to icariin
ATM-mutant lines (SNU685, 786O, SNUC5) appear in the killed set, suggesting defective DNA-damage response sensitizes to icariin-induced stress
STK11-mutant lines (KALS1, SNU840) are among the most-killed, consistent with metabolic/AMPK vulnerability
NF2-mutant lines (S117, SNU840) appear in the killed set, possibly via Hippo-YAP dependence
